digest.component_or_area: rebar search command and result schema
propositions: rebar search returns full ticket descriptions and all comment bodies by default, causing excessive output size (~203 KB) and exhausting agent context during discovery operations
search command lacks --output flag support; passing --output json is rejected as unknown option rather than recognized as a valid format specifier
default search results should project only eight discovery fields (ticket_id, alias, title, ticket_type, status, priority, summary, snippet) with full descriptions and comments omitted
search summaries must be derived from stored summary field if present, else truncated description, normalized to at most 240 characters, or null if both sources are absent or empty

search snippets must be case-preserving, bounded context windows of at most 240 characters centered on the first matching positive free-text term, extracted from the field containing the match, with null for predicate-only queries

rebar search --full should restore legacy full-TicketState JSON output as migration path, while rebar search --output llm should emit minified newline-delimited JSON with dedicated SEARCH_RESULT_LLM schema; --full and --output llm together must reject with incompatibility error
